title: Care checks what it does not know

captions.emotions: Feeling warmth in acceptance and involvement

meaning: Your care can offer acceptance when creating good conditions allows needs to be clarified rather than treating a personal guess as certainty.
text: Warm help does not require knowing beforehand exactly what will delight the other. In the physical position of Anahata, the Moon describes actions among unclear impressions: an assumption may lead towards involvement but needs clarification. The Empress in energy brings a wish to nourish what is alive and create comfort and conditions for growth. The Empress in emotions offers acceptance, warmth and room for yourself. Surrounding each other with attention may matter while keeping an imagined need distinct from an actual one feels difficult. Tenderness stays attentive to a real answer even when it changes an attractive plan.

For example, one plans to bring flowers for the other’s new workspace after noticing an empty windowsill. Checking reveals a wish to grow herbs there. **Care nourishes what is alive when it hears a correction to its guess.** Choosing pots can receive help instead of a ready bouquet. The action does not prove wordless guessing ability, while warmth grows from an acknowledged wish and room to arrange a place personally.

Difficulty appears if comfort becomes a picture the other must conform to. Alternatively, every unclear sign produces another offer without waiting for an answer. Care allows knowledge to have limits. Delight can be wanted and an impression distinguished from a request without considering either a changed gift or another view of beauty proof of ingratitude or failed involvement.
